author: Ankit
problem: Words are placed on lines left to right with one space between neighbouring words, and a line holds at most width characters. Every word fits on a line by itself. Return how many lines the words need.
bug_description: The fit check leaves out the space before the next word, so a line can end up one character over the width.

comments.accurate: Number of lines needed to wrap the words at the given width
comments.wrong_behavior: Wraps words at the width; the spaces between words don't count toward it
comments.wrong_location: Line-fit check verified; make sure the first word always starts a line
